items.contentSnippet: See how LSEG uses OpenAI to scale trusted AI across its global business, accelerating insights, shrinking release cycles, and empowering 4,000 employees.

summaries.zh: 路透社集团（LSEG）利用OpenAI技术，在全球业务中推广可信人工智能，加速洞察生成，缩短产品发布周期，并赋能4000名员工。通过数据驱动决策，LSEG实现了AI的规模化应用，提升了业务效率。
summaries.en: LSEG leverages OpenAI to scale trusted AI across its global operations. The integration accelerates insights, reduces release cycles, and empowers 4,000 employees. The approach enhances efficiency and decision-making while maintaining reliability.

items.title: How engineers at Nextdoor use Codex to build without limits

summaries.en: Engineers at Nextdoor leverage Codex with GPT-5.5 to investigate challenging, hard-to-reproduce issues. They utilize the tool to build cross-platform solutions and prioritize product outcomes, enhancing their development efficiency.

items.title: Industrial policy for the Intelligence Age
items.content: Explore our ambitious, people-first industrial policy ideas for the AI era—focused on expanding opportunity, sharing prosperity, and building resilient institutions as advanced intelligence evolves.
items.contentSnippet: Explore our ambitious, people-first industrial policy ideas for the AI era—focused on expanding opportunity, sharing prosperity, and building resilient institutions as advanced intelligence evolves.

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了面向人工智能时代的人本工业政策构想。政策旨在扩大发展机遇、共享繁荣成果，并构建适应高级智能发展的韧性制度。核心目标是通过政策引导，促进智能时代的产业升级与社会公平。
summaries.en: The article outlines an ambitious, people-first industrial policy for the AI era. It emphasizes expanding opportunity, sharing prosperity, and building resilient institutions as advanced intelligence develops. The policy aims to address the challenges and opportunities presented by artificial intelligence while prioritizing societal well-being and adaptability.

items.summary: 本文探讨了面向人工智能时代的人本工业政策构想。政策旨在扩大发展机遇、共享繁荣成果，并构建适应高级智能发展的韧性制度。核心目标是通过政策引导，促进智能时代的产业升级与社会公平。

items.title: Built to benefit everyone: our plan
items.content: A vision for the future of AI, focusing on access, safety, and shared prosperity as OpenAI works to ensure AGI benefits everyone.
items.contentSnippet: A vision for the future of AI, focusing on access, safety, and shared prosperity as OpenAI works to ensure AGI benefits everyone.

summaries.zh: 本文阐述了OpenAI对人工智能未来的愿景，强调以普及、安全及共享繁荣为核心，致力于确保通用人工智能（AGI）惠及所有人。
summaries.en: OpenAI's plan outlines a vision for the future of AI, emphasizing access, safety, and shared prosperity. The goal is to ensure that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) benefits all individuals. The initiative aims to make AI technologies widely available, secure, and equitable, fostering positive outcomes for society.

items.summary: 本文阐述了OpenAI对人工智能未来的愿景，强调以普及、安全及共享繁荣为核心，致力于确保通用人工智能（AGI）惠及所有人。
